lesson: A causally correct intervention point is necessary but not sufficient for a useful counterfactual metric. Absolute cosine to a full sentence can remain high when the decisive value token is removed because subject, attribute, syntax, and surrounding semantics dominate the embedding.
action: Before authorizing repair or scaling, run a diagnostic matched target-vs-stale foil margin under the same pre-fusion ablation. Preserve the frozen FAIL unchanged and do not train on challenge rows.

lesson: Do not infer undercapacity from parameter-count aesthetics or a single counterfactual metric failure. Scale only after measurements isolate representational capacity as the bottleneck rather than objective, intervention, or metric sensitivity.
